text:
maria: CI shows 7% 99p regression on matmul-quant build on p4s under small-batch load. logs attached.
kevin: I can repro with the new matmul kernel variant; likely scheduler change causing KV churn.
ana: eviction rate spikes when GPU clocks dip; thermal pattern.
maria: plan: immediate night-bucket pin to v2.14.6, prepare hotpatch that selects legacy matmul via env, then targeted canary 5% us-west 30m.
kevin: hotpatch will use RUNTIME_MATMUL_VARIANT=legacy and a fast switch; no ABI changes.
dena: ops: pin via deploybot with ttl 12h. command: `deploybot pin --service runtime --version v2.14.6 --scope region:us-west --ttl 12h`
Tom: QA will run perf harness and small prompt smoke during canary; will report metrics.
maria: Gates: 5xx <0.1%, 99p < baseline+15%, eviction <=1.2x. auto-pin on failure and notify oncall.
deploy-bot: preflight done: runtime-v2.14.7-quant status=unstable (perf-telemetry failing).
kevin: I'll open hotpatch PR and enable per-op histograms after deploy.
maria: timeline: pin in 10m, hotpatch PR in 45m, canary at +1h. update in thread in 30m. :thumbsup:
